climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Missouri AVA of 1.28 million acres in the Ozark Mountains, east of Jefferson City, around Rolla. It borders the Mark Twain National Forest. It was created on a petition from seven Missouri wineries and sits within Ozark Mountain.
